newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks hover in positive territory.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks hover in positive territory.

text.p: Tokyo stocks hovered quietly in positive territory in the Friday afternoon session lifted mostly by short-covering of bank shares, brokers said. They added that the market was fairly quiet ahead of the weekend.
As of 0418 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 74.90 points or 0.36 percent at 20,639.36. Its September futures were up 150 at 20,740.
"The market always runs out of energy after the futures and options settlements and today is no exception," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
